pages.text: The $(blood)Blood-Infused Spellbook$() is an enhanced spellbook that channels Life Essence to boost your spellcasting. Created by infusing any Iron's Spells spellbook at a Blood Altar, it can be upgraded through 6 tiers for increasing power.

$(bold)Creating the Spellbook$()$(br2)Hold any Iron's Spells spellbook and right-click a $(blood)Tier 3+$() Blood Altar with at least $(blood)10,000 LP$(). Your spellbook will be transformed into a Blood-Infused Spellbook at Tier 1.

pages.title: Upgrading Tiers
pages.text: To upgrade your spellbook, right-click a Blood Altar while holding it. Each tier requires:$(br2)$(li)Sufficient LP in the altar$(li)A Blood Orb of the target tier in your inventory$(br2)$(bold)Upgrade Costs:$()$(br)Tier 1: 10,000 LP$(br)Tier 2: 15,000 LP$(br)Tier 3: 25,000 LP$(br)Tier 4: 50,000 LP$(br)Tier 5: 100,000 LP$(br)Tier 6: 175,000 LP

pages.title: Tier Bonuses
pages.text: $(bold)Spell Slot Bonuses:$()$(br)$(li)Tier 1: +1 slot (6 total)$(li)Tier 2: +2 slots (7 total)$(li)Tier 3: +3 slots (8 total)$(br2)$(bold)LP Cost Reduction:$()$(br)$(li)Tier 4: -10% LP cost$(li)Tier 5-6: -20% LP cost$(br2)$(bold)Lifesteal:$()$(br)$(li)Tier 6: 5% lifesteal on spells

pages.title: Blood Orb Requirements
pages.text: Each upgrade tier requires a Blood Orb of that tier or higher in your inventory:$(br2)$(li)Tier 1: Weak Blood Orb$(li)Tier 2: Apprentice Blood Orb$(li)Tier 3: Magician's Blood Orb$(li)Tier 4: Master Blood Orb$(li)Tier 5: Archmage's Blood Orb$(li)Tier 6: Transcendent Blood Orb$(br2)The orb is not consumed during upgrades.
